name: Hidaka Chihiro
source:
He has a passion for flying and he’s in love with the sky. He’s the only disciple of Orikura Renji, the champion of flying and hero of Amahara. But because of an accident, he quit flying as he has trauma of flight. Because of that, he now wonders aimlessly as he has lost the only goal in his life. And yes, he’s the kind of "kind to every girl but never made a move" kinda guy.
